Package com.noorlandmc.NoorEntities.ai.beta.sensors

Interface MannequinSensor

All Known Implementing Classes:
NearestItemSensor
public interface MannequinSensor
The contract every mannequin sensor must satisfy.

Sensors are observers — they perceive the world around the mannequin and write structured results into the mannequin's PersistentDataContainer (PDC) so that MannequinGoals can read perception data without duplicating scanning logic.

Unlike goals, sensors have no priority ordering or start/stop lifecycle. Every registered sensor is ticked unconditionally by the SensorSelector on its configured interval, and it is responsible for keeping its PDC entries up-to-date.

Typical contract:

  • When a sensor finds something relevant it writes one or more PDC keys (e.g. the UUID of the nearest item entity).
  • When the condition no longer holds the sensor removes those keys so goals see a clean "nothing found" state.
  • Goals read the PDC key at their own tick rate — they never call the sensor directly.

Lifecycle:

  1. onRegister(org.bukkit.entity.Mannequin) is called once when the sensor is added to a SensorSelector.
  2. sense(org.bukkit.entity.Mannequin) is called every intervalTicks() ticks by the SensorSelector.
  3. onUnregister(org.bukkit.entity.Mannequin) is called once when the sensor is removed, giving it a chance to clean up any PDC keys it wrote.

  • Method Details

    • getKey

      SensorKey getKey()
      Returns the unique key for this sensor. Used by SensorSelector for lookup and removal.
      Returns:
      this sensor's SensorKey

    • intervalTicks

      default int intervalTicks()
      How many brain ticks to wait between calls to sense(org.bukkit.entity.Mannequin).

      A value of 1 means sense every brain tick. A value of 5 means sense every fifth brain tick. Stagger different sensors across different intervals to spread the CPU cost of world-scanning.

      Defaults to 1 (every brain tick).

      Returns:
      interval in brain ticks (≥ 1)

    • onRegister

      default void onRegister(org.bukkit.entity.Mannequin mannequin)
      Called once when this sensor is added to a SensorSelector. Override to perform one-time setup (e.g. pre-compute NamespacedKeys).
      Parameters:
      mannequin - the mannequin this sensor is attached to

    • sense

      void sense(org.bukkit.entity.Mannequin mannequin)
      Called on every tick (subject to intervalTicks()). The sensor should scan the world and write/remove PDC keys on mannequin to reflect what it perceived.
      Parameters:
      mannequin - the mannequin this sensor is attached to

    • onUnregister

      default void onUnregister(org.bukkit.entity.Mannequin mannequin)
      Called once when this sensor is removed from a SensorSelector or when SensorSelector.clearAll(org.bukkit.entity.Mannequin) is called. Override to remove any PDC keys this sensor may have written so the mannequin's PDC stays clean.
      Parameters:
      mannequin - the mannequin this sensor is attached to
